notes.title: Otherworldly Update - 12/21/24
notes.content:
The update "Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift" is out. Here are the changes, grouped by sections:

[h2][b]Graphics and Interface[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a character body.
[*] Created a user-friendly tablet interface.
[*] Redesigned the HUD for both with and without the suit.
[*] Revamped the main menu.
[*] Added a convenient mode selection menu.
[*] Improved graphics.
[*] Fixed issues with shadows and lighting.
[/list]

[h2][b]Gameplay Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a system for saving the state of objects on maps.
[*] Redesigned the in-game time system.
[*] Redesigned the save system.
[*] Added music and sound effects.
[*] Added new items to the shop, such as ammunition, medkits, and suit batteries.
[*] Added weapons to the suit.
[*] Implemented weight limits.
[*] Introduced convenient device switching.
[*] Added artifacts and weekly quests.
[*] Added notes and totems.
[*] Introduced a system for ordering items.
[/list]

[h2][b]Story and Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a storyline.
[*] Introduced mutants and anomalies in parallel worlds.
[*] Added achievements.
[*] Added several parallel worlds.
[*] Introduced a starting location in parallel worlds.
[*] Relocated the order delivery area from the shop.
[/list]

[h2][b]Tutorial and Guidance[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial on the first launch.
[*] Added a guide for using devices.
[/list]

[h2][b]Optimization and Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to exiting the computer.
[*] Fixed a bug with report submissions.
[*] Resolved an issue with world changes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the pause menu.
[*] Improved optimization.
[/list]

[h2][b]Shop and Inventory[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Created an inventory system.
[*] Added a shopping cart to the store.
[/list]

[h2][b]Voiceover and Sound[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Russian and English voiceovers.
[*] Introduced a volume slider for music, sounds, and voices.
[/list]

[h2][b]New Interface Elements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a compass and markers for important events.
[*] Added a task list.
[/list]

[h2][b]Map[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the map.
[/list]

This is not the last update! We are already working on a new major update, which will include: even more story elements, multiplayer, a sandbox mode, and many other exciting features.

[b]Sincerely,
Good Face Team.[/b]

notes.title: Update Compiled for Otherworldly
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that we’ve successfully compiled the update for Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift! We understand you’ve been eagerly waiting, and we sincerely apologize for the delay.

This update includes improvements, bug fixes, and new features that will make the game even more engaging and immersive. The full list of changes will be shared alongside the update.

Stay tuned to be among the first to download the update and explore all the new features! Thank you for your patience and continued support.

notes.title: Development of "Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift" Temporarily Paused
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends and fans of Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift![/b]

Unfortunately, we have to announce that the development of the game is temporarily on hold due to technical reasons. The main issue lies with our current hardware, which, unfortunately, cannot handle compiling the new version of the game.

This decision was not easy for us, but it’s necessary to ensure we can deliver a high-quality and complete project in the future.

However, we want to assure you that this is not the end! We are determined and full of enthusiasm to continue creating games. We will learn from this experience, strengthen our capabilities, and come back stronger than ever.

Thank you for your support and belief in us. We’re not giving up, and our creative plans remain ambitious! Stay tuned for updates, and we’ll see you in new worlds.

[b]Sincerely,
Good Face Team[/b]

notes.title: Experiment Time | Update v0.0.3
notes.content:
In January 2025, Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift will receive a long-awaited update that will drastically change the gameplay! This update brings a story mode, dynamic shooting, terrifying monsters, and new parallel worlds to explore. You’ll experience a fresh interface, intuitive inventory, achievements, and notes to help you dive deeper into the game’s story.

Key Features:
[list]
[b][*] New Story Journey and Powerful Combat System: Explore every corner of the world and fight terrifying monsters.
[*] Expanded Interaction Opportunities: A new main location, a vehicle for fast travel, and an underground lab.
[*] Artifact Search System and Daily Missions: Find artifacts in parallel worlds to complete daily tasks.
[*] Updated Interface and Inventory: Easy access to everything you need, right at your fingertips.
[*] Fixes and Improvements: A new world identification system, text-based tutorials for beginners, and significantly improved optimization.[/b]
[/list]
And that’s not the full list of changes—there’s even more to come!
